_comment: Hosts are added BY HAND, one at a time, after reading the host's robots.txt and site terms. Each entry needs checked_at (YYYY-MM-DD) and a note saying what was read (CLAUDE.md legal guardrail 5). Empty means no JSON-LD or Zoho source can be ingested yet. pnpm discover:v2 writes candidates to .cache/discovery/v2 for review; it never edits this file.
